description: This file is a PHP script for initiating and managing the upgrade process in SuiteCRM, including logging, setting upgrade progress, handling session flags, displaying user interface components, and managing upgrade steps.

methods.name: logThis
methods.description: Logs messages related to the start of the upgrade process.

methods.name: set_upgrade_progress
methods.description: Sets the current progress state of the upgrade process.

methods.name: unlinkUWTempFiles
methods.description: Removes temporary files related to the upgrade wizard.

methods.name: resetUwSession
methods.description: Resets session variables used during the upgrade process.
